subject: [hw] T02 -> V40: load-time `set WIN OFF VALUE` rule added (6170/6170)
body:
As promised, the fake now supports a load-time default:
  set VDEC_SYS 0x0004 0x00000000
  set VENC 0x0008 0xdeadbeef
It is written when n2vc_hw_fake_script() loads the file, does not require the block to be powered (it is initial state, not a register access), and is recorded as "SCRIPT default WIN 0xOFF = 0xVALUE". apply_rules ignores it. Grammar/README updated; tests/hw/scripts/defaults.txt plus a check added. Current acceptance:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6170/6170
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/check/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-check PASS 22/22
No interface change beyond the optional grammar line.
